title: Keumgang

note.p: Keumgang means diamond, the hardest thing there is; the name also recalls Keumgangsan, the Diamond Mountains. The floor line is 山 (mountain). Move with weight and calm, and hold each crane stance still.

footer: Move numbers follow the Kukkiwon movement count (27 movements); a kick and the techniques that follow it in the same movement share one number (one figure per movement). Finish with Baro: draw the left foot in and return to the ready stance facing ga.

moves.desc: Stand at na facing ga, feet parallel and one foot-width apart, fists in front of the belt (gibon junbi).
Step forward toward ga into a left front stance. Inner-forearm opening block (an palmok momtong hecho makki).
Step forward into a right front stance. Right palm-heel jaw strike.
Step forward into a left front stance. Left palm-heel jaw strike.
Step forward into a right front stance. Right palm-heel jaw strike.
Step back with the right foot into a back stance with the left foot forward. Left knife-hand inside block.
Step back with the left foot into a back stance with the right foot forward. Right knife-hand inside block.
Step back with the right foot into a back stance with the left foot forward. Left knife-hand inside block.
Lift the left foot to the right knee: crane stance on the right leg, looking left toward da. Diamond block, slowly: left low block, right high block.
Step the left foot down toward da into a horse stance. Large hinge: left elbow out toward da, right fist across the chest.
Turn 360° to the left, travelling toward da, and land in a horse stance. Large hinge again.
Turn 90° left to face da and stamp into a horse stance. Mountain block.
Turn 180° to the right, stepping round to face ra, horse stance. Inner-forearm opening block.
Draw the left foot in to a parallel stance. Low spread block, slowly.
Turn 180° to the right to face da and stamp into a horse stance. Mountain block.
Turn to face ga and lift the right foot to the left knee: crane stance on the left leg, looking right toward ra. Diamond block, slowly.
Step the right foot down toward ra into a horse stance. Large hinge: right elbow out toward ra, left fist across the chest.
Turn 360° to the right, travelling toward ra, and land in a horse stance. Large hinge again.
Lift the right foot to the left knee: crane stance on the left leg, looking toward ra. Diamond block, slowly.
Step the right foot down toward ra into a horse stance. Large hinge.
Turn 360° to the right, travelling toward ra, and land in a horse stance. Large hinge again.
Turn 90° right to face ra and stamp into a horse stance. Mountain block.
Turn 180° to the left, stepping round to face da, horse stance. Inner-forearm opening block.
Draw the right foot in to a parallel stance. Low spread block, slowly.
Turn 180° to the left to face ra and stamp into a horse stance. Mountain block.
Turn to face ga and lift the left foot to the right knee: crane stance on the right leg, looking left toward da. Diamond block, slowly.
Step the left foot down toward da into a horse stance. Large hinge.
Turn 360° to the left, travelling toward da, and land in a horse stance. Large hinge again.
